basis: script/m14/tmp/family-line-identity.ts — one two-site snippet per lane (same callee, two lines, one caller). `per-site` means the line is part of the edge identity key (two edges, each with its own line); `per-set` means the key collapses them (the pre-M59.A7 shape). Complements M60.P1/LCM `lines` field-presence with the identity half.
